dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Its wounds are beginning to heal. Condition: stable.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So that doc's medicine worked after all... Is it still in pain?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Pain is unavoidable. However, it will surely recover soon.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Okay, Ineffa! Next up, make us some cakes. Oh, and krumkakes too! I bet it's gonna be starving when it wakes up!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: You are speaking on your behalf, Aino, not the deer's. But rest assured. I have a recipe for animal food, which I will prepare shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: You cannot consume food meant for animals, Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hey! I wasn't thinking about stealing a sick deer's lunch, okay?!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: We are. We encountered this deer under a cliff. It appeared to have fallen to the bottom of the cliff, and it was badly injured.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Therefore, we brought it to a town to visit a doctor. We also acquired medicine for it.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Our current plan is to care for the deer until its wounds heal. Afterwards, we will bring it to a nearby forest before returning it to its herd.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's the matter, Aino?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Aino, we have discussed this before.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: I can take care of it! I'll get up early to feed it. Heck, I'll even brush its fur!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: The previous time you got up early to feed it, you hugged it and fell back asleep. Both you and the deer only finished half of your breakfast portions.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Well! That was a... Umm... That's...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: When you were brushing its fur yesterday, you played ball with it, successfully distributing its fur to every corner of the room.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: And it clogged my vacuum cleaner when I tried to clean it up.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: I just couldn't help playing with it! Fine, I'm sorry... I guess...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: But even if you say all that, I...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Nngh... I wanna keep it as a pet!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: I'm already used to waking up early, giving it water, brushing its fur, then playing with it...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: If it suddenly leaves... I'll have trouble adjusting! The deer will too!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Look! Even the deer doesn't wanna go!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I am incapable of understanding deer speech, Aino.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Well, just look at it! Haven't you heard, "actions speak louder than words"? It loves me thiiis much!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Ugh, if only the deer could talk! It could do all the persuading then...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: And then I could tell it to stop helping you eat the vegetables in your breakfast every morning.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: I— Whuh?! Ineffa, how... how'd you know...?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I did not know. It was merely a guess. You have proven it correct.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Ugh, you're such a big, sneaky, lying meanie, Ineffa!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Tomorrow morning, I will supervise both of you as you take your breakfast.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Someone who's good at speaking to animals, and can understand them...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If Lauma were here, then maybe...

choices.text: You've got a kind heart, Aino.
Are you taking care of it?
